programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

鳳凰洲際快車 (9226)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰洲際快車》是鳳凰衛視子夜時段的新聞資訊節目,為您帶來兩岸三地,以及國際社會的大小新聞、最新動態和局勢發展。

programme.title: 文化大觀園 (460)
programme.desc: 《文化大觀園》:節目關注中華文化中的大事件、大歷史、大人物和新發現,在紛繁的生活中給您清靜、雅致的空間,並通過我們的鏡頭去探尋中華文明中充滿迷幻、離奇的人物和故事。

programme.title: 鳳凰大健康 (372)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰大健康》:節目將由來自中西醫的健康科普專家和全球首個“智能醫生組成健康科普主持團,並將每期邀請一位頂級醫療專家作為嘉賓,集合中西的理論精華,配合妙趣橫生的人工智慧互動對熱點的健康科普話題進行權威深入解讀。

programme.title: 紀錄大時代 (1408)
programme.desc: 《紀錄大時代》:紀錄珍貴片段,重溫精彩大時代,《紀錄大時代》為您精選鳳凰優秀紀錄片,把歷史再次真實地呈現眼前。

programme.title: 香港新視點 (492)
programme.desc: 《香港新視點》透過訪問特區政府官員、學者、焦點事件的相關人物,以及採訪兩地的年輕人的交流團等,讓觀眾透徹了解香港以至內地政治文化,加深對國情的認識。

programme.title: 新聞今日談 (8226)
programme.desc: 《新聞今日談》:節目針對當天最熱門時事問題,在觀眾最關注的時刻即時作出評論,讓觀眾更洞悉事件的真相。

programme.title: 築夢天下 (467)
programme.desc: 《築夢天下》尋找中外不同風格的建築、民居,道出背後的環境因素和地理條件,詳述生活於其間的人物,細訴人和建築之間糾纏不清的故事。

programme.title: 風雲對話 (406)
programme.desc: 《風雲對話》是一個高素質的訪談節目,節目採訪全球“最關鍵、最前線、最敏感權傾一時的掌權者,他們影響並決定著整個國際局勢的變化和發展。一個個世界級人物在節目中,親自向您剖析他們的觀點。

programme.title: 近觀中國 (211)
programme.desc: 《近觀中國》:全新推出的觀察類紀錄片欄目。每一期以一名外國人為主角,遊走中國各地,以近距離的視角觀察中國社會狀況和中國人的生活。

programme.title: 我的香港故事 (211)
programme.desc: 《我的香港故事》:人物記錄專題欄目。通過每集大約15分鐘的精致篇幅,講述香港人的故事與發生的事。為全國華人觀眾,了解香港新的視覺。

programme.title: 笑逐言開 (615)
programme.desc: 《笑逐言開》是節目運用嶄新的多媒體手段和獨特的串連解讀方式,通過主持人現場脫口秀來演繹各類資訊,帶給您更有營養的週末。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 越南漆器工藝需要不斷反覆進行上漆和打磨的工序, 是一種需要耐心等待嘅藝術 由以往只應用在寺廟或祠堂, 時至今日越南漆藝已經擴展到日常生活，由漆器到漆畫，由傳統工藝到新式工藝。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥德拉厄，這個船長小鎮，早年是鯡魚貿易中心，後海港沒落，繁華已逝，但老城區依然保留兩百年前的風貌。印度梅加拉亞邦是全國最不想生兒子的地方。女兒國凱西族婦女享有獨特社會地位，扮演著維繫家族血脈的角色。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 「閨密旅行團」正式出遊！陳敏之偕同高海寧、龔嘉欣前赴馬來西亞華人新村，選購地道特產，不忘展現慳家人妻本色，跟檔主講價。黎諾懿化身神秘檔主，為美女們送上驚喜。諾懿反客為主，推介環境清幽的竹林餐廳，品嚐農家菜與滋味河鮮。在豪華大屋安頓後，四人一邊打邊爐，一邊細說心底話。敏之提到想坐時光機回到過去再見亡父，不禁感觸落淚；嘉欣亦遺憾未能見爺爺最後一面。高Ling卻對生仔時刻充滿期待，難道有好消息準備公佈？

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 現時乘搭鐵路前往港島南方便快捷，陸浩明、容羨媛和梁麗翹從香港仔出發，實行吃盡、玩盡南區好去處。香港仔生猛海鮮遠近馳名，三人登上海鮮舫「偷師」，窺探大廚炮製火焰蝦的過程；及後走進漁民飯堂，一嚐即買即吃海鮮滋味。在數碼港廣闊草地野餐，極盡寫意。六號公開展示桌球技術，莫非要成為下一位「神奇小子」？在日落美景前歎盡精采美食，為周末假期畫上完美句號。兩位女生到臨五星級酒店，原來還為了一睹「靚仔」餅師的風采！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 「光環效應」是一種心理學上的認知偏差，意指人們會因人或事物的某個正面特質而將好印象擴散到整體評價。與之相反的是「角魔效應」，谷主瀅仴提到，這可從某齣時尚主題的荷里活電影中充分體現。兩種效應都反映了形象管理的重要，商品找明星代言正是利用這心理作用。人類重視第一印象，或源於大腦希望節省能量？谷主們討論光環效應可能產生的負面影響與應對方法。現今社會，藝人的日常生活更容易曝光，眾谷主可會擔心形象受此影響？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 都市人普遍多肉少菜，未能符合均衡飲食之道，就讓「食肉獸」翠如藉這集的蔬菜主題，領略素菜好滋味。素冬瓜盅採用羊肚菌、黃耳等有營食材，配合素湯湯底，清潤鮮甜！家嘉乾煎大蘑菇，釀入芝士黑松露菇粒，竟可焗出素牛扒的感覺？詩雅不愛吃茄子，保哥用開胃醬汁扭轉其味道，以「涼拌三椒茄子」令她改觀！家嘉則巧製「彩虹慢燉茄子塔」，色彩繽紛的食材配酥皮，演繹軟脆雙重口感。此外，嚳儀藉「桂花酸梅湯凍小丸子」帶出家鄉風味。

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 離中秋仍有一段日子，但就像翠如所講，預留時間學煮，屆時慶節就剛剛好！保哥呈獻「黃金鮑魚」，將生粉與吉士粉混合成炸粉，有何作用？家嘉送上加入煙肉的「法式青口煲」，為吃慣了白酒菜式的翠如帶來新鮮感。保哥炒好類似弄越南春卷的餡料，釀進魷魚筒內再煎香，造型如藝術品，卻吃出意料不及的柔軟質感。詩雅幫忙炸出的薄脆，配合由志恒拿捏好時間煎熟的帶子，再加上家嘉精心調製的醬汁，成為近乎完美的「柚香帶子薄脆」！

programme.title: 聲級學堂粵
programme.desc: 上一集，四組學員為考核全力以赴，成績卻未見突出。餘下的六組學員，能否從考官手上取得佳績？有學員全情投入聲演，七情上面時不慎走音。萬眾期待的「黑馬」組合，卻令考官大跌眼鏡。相反，同一條《金宵大廈》母子溫情片段，某組的合拍默契令人刮目相看！有組合為「馬季」、「啤啤」跳脫演繹；「小丸子」和「小玉」重新配音後，竟變出另類效果？十組學員完成考核，最優秀的三位配音學員順利誕生！鳳英老師、眾學員亦會剖白感受。

programme.title: 永續未來 - TVB環境、社會及管治大獎頒獎典禮2025粵
programme.desc: 在全球重視可持續發展的趨勢下，「TVB環境、社會及管治大獎2025」吸引251間企業參與，創歷屆新高。此外，今屆首度夥拍生產力局增設「中小企ESG卓越大獎」，鼓勵中小企綠色轉型。節目中更走訪由堆填區活化而成的「東華三院環保村」如何從環保、教育與康樂推動ESG，亦會解構渠務署如何利用創新科技提升城市的排洪能力。頒獎禮上，各得獎者亦分享推行ESG的心得，鼓勵同業仿效，攜手構建可持續未來。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 面對明天的東北地區大賽，蒼秀館男子韻律體操隊聽從志田教練指導，養精蓄銳，不作任何練習。然而，大家在休息時，內心仍然惦記著體操的動作，輕鬆不下來，惟有以不同方法分散注意力��…

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: Mandy姐姐這次要引領大家「前往」主題樂園進行全身肌力訓練，而部份動作會令人聯想起咖啡杯、旋轉木馬、摩天輪等機動遊戲，究竟怎樣做？「WORKOUT 2GETHER」的第二個訓練是強化核心肌肉，動作包括躺在地上舉腳、趴地模仿游泳等。全程要收緊腹部，才可達至更佳鍛練效果。另外，「動物好萌友」環節介紹南跳岩企鵝。牠擁有一雙醒目的黃色眉毛，辨認度極高！同場還可看到牠的好鄰居巴布亞企鵝，兩者如何和諧共處？

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子看到飲食節目介紹蟹後，要求家裡吃蟹但遭拒絕，小丸子把心一橫，決定用自己的壓歲錢買蟹。小丸子經常忘記行程，得知城崎有用記事簿的習慣後，決定有樣學樣，央求媽媽買記事簿給她。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
programme.desc: 近年中醫藥的應用越來越普及，不少市民都會買中成藥傍身。但原來根據中醫藥條例，中成藥必須「純粹」由中藥材製成，換言之只要成分有一種非中藥成份，即使與中成藥同名，在法例上也不算是中成藥，不受相關法例規管，可以當成普通食品出售，對市民的安全健康會否構成威脅？即使是註冊中成藥，若果不當服用，同樣會損害健康，但本港所有中成藥都無需醫生處方或藥劑師監督便能購買，規範又是否足夠？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 一段群鼠在大埔粉麵店外狂噬生豬肉的駭人片段網上瘋傳，店方隨即發聲明指斥屬AI生成惡意誹謗，記者尋得拍片者現身對質。黃子華、鄭秀文主演賀歲片，戲迷熱切期待，二人爆笑推介精彩場口！痛失愛犬女狗主，透過監控鏡頭驚見菲律賓籍家傭向愛犬連環飛腳踢肚再狂踩，家傭雖被告上法庭但案件再無下文，數月後她竟接獲中介公司通知涉案家傭已獲釋？全城關注交通事故問題，有工程車司機親述與的士因讓車問題在路面對峙，場面有多驚險？

programme.title: 京東呈獻：愛心改造家粵
programme.desc: 阿惠一家五口住在手機地圖找不到的偏僻鐵皮屋，回家路上隨時遇到蛇、野豬等動物，暴雨時又驚怕洪水；等了八年終於「上樓」，一於將新居設計交予宅Sir！女士需要的收納空間、梳妝空間甚多，宅Sir如何滿足眾人需求？用櫃來間出房間，櫃背要花少許心思去美化。阿惠的朋友送上二手冷氣機作新居禮物，使用前要怎樣做好深層清潔？阿惠的三名女兒亦藉畫作以增加家居的獨特性，並記載家庭溫馨，還繪寫心意咭答謝兩主持和宅Sir。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！曾跟幾位歌唱老師學習的鬼馬「Gen Z」、自認有「絕對音準」的少女、贏過歌唱比賽獎項的「實戰派」挑戰者，分別接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 從14歲入行，陳松伶自言「人未長高已看懂人生」，並帶來經典作品<天涯歌女、新歌<松伶，讓觀眾更認識她。向大家打招呼，還預告將有表白歌推出！周吉佩到場演繹虐心新歌<為何我比不上他，聽得主持曾展望、莊子璇都覺悲痛。熱愛創作歌曲的Winky黃健怡，第三次跟填詞人黃偉文合作的<超級市場關門前，如何讓她做到自我反省？

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 糖於烹調中有着不可取代的地位，中國不同地方對糖的運用各具心得。四川廚師擅長將糖與豬油混合，製成甜燒白等菜式，呈現複合的甜味。蘇州水鄉盛產雞頭米，這種食材自帶清甜，當地人常用來煮成各式糖水。馬來西亞有一個依海而生的民族，大部份生活所需取自海洋。他們以新鮮海膽製作飯團，展現最天然的甜鮮滋味。地爐燒豬是香港碩果僅存的傳統燒味工藝，要烤出焦香脆口的外皮，用麥芽糖上「皮水」正是成就這經典風味的關鍵。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 柔道代表李玨穎、射擊女將成灝澂，都獲提名新一屆香港傑出運動員選舉的不同獎項，這集回看兩人於2025年的超卓表現。此外，逾二百名健兒出席傑運記招，送上花絮。香港國際馬術盛典圓滿舉行，大獎賽、青年挑戰賽等戰況有多激烈？一百名足球小精英與三位東方現役足球員同場較量，鼓勵小將勇於向夢想挑戰。啟德體育嘉年華集結不同攤位、體驗；體操名將石偉雄出席健身室活動，推動大家多做運動。另帶來港隊征戰米蘭冬奧的授旗儀式。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 國際金價屢創新高，包括黃金在內，現時全球貴金屬市場的形勢如何？科技公司紛紛投資發展AI，導致全球記憶體出現供不應求，情況如何？

programme.title: 有個閨密叫祖藍粵
programme.desc: 久未於電視螢幕露面的苑瓊丹，這次應邀和祖藍共聚。先考驗兩位搞笑高手的演技，隔着板，丹姐只憑聲音與表情，已猜出祖藍吃的是豬肉乾！期間，她還大抛金句，最美滿婚姻是要「放任」？在電視台打滾多年，演員難免有被冷待的時刻，丹姐卻藉此練得周身刀。拍攝代表作之一《封神榜》時，丹姐憶起未能照顧患病母親，慨嘆演員身不由己，一時感觸……祖藍招呼丹姐豪歎海鮮火鍋，同時來一場「真心話」逆轉版比拼，兩人更自揭不少拍戲內幕！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 一段群鼠在大埔粉麵店外狂噬生豬肉的駭人片段網上瘋傳，店方隨即發聲明指斥屬AI生成惡意誹謗，記者尋得拍片者現身對質。黃子華、鄭秀文主演賀歲片，戲迷熱切期待，二人爆笑推介精彩場口！痛失愛犬女狗主，透過監控鏡頭驚見菲律賓籍家傭向愛犬連環飛腳踢肚再狂踩，家傭雖被告上法庭但案件再無下文，數月後她竟接獲中介公司通知涉案家傭已獲釋？全城關注交通事故問題，有工程車司機親述與的士因讓車問題在路面對峙，場面有多驚險？

programme.title: 溜走的真味粵
programme.desc: 對於用米製作食品，潮汕人別具心得，粿條、腸粉等皆為米製美食。潮州粥配上稱為「雜鹹」的潮汕冷盤小菜，就是當地人的日常滋味。主持與嘉賓楊潮凱看到桌上108道雜鹹，未吃已感震撼！用糯米包出的「糭球」，可一次嚐到鹹甜兩種味道；由海中薄殼加工而來的「薄殼米」，又是地道的潮汕風味，還可製成薄殼米粿。三姐配合米製品主題，炮製「老菜脯蜆蟹粥」、「薄殼韭菜煎蛋角」與「沙嗲豬肉鴛鴦麵」。粥品僅加入魚露，已經鮮味無窮。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 現時乘搭鐵路前往港島南方便快捷，陸浩明、容羨媛和梁麗翹從香港仔出發，實行吃盡、玩盡南區好去處。香港仔生猛海鮮遠近馳名，三人登上海鮮舫「偷師」，窺探大廚炮製火焰蝦的過程；及後走進漁民飯堂，一嚐即買即吃海鮮滋味。在數碼港廣闊草地野餐，極盡寫意。六號公開展示桌球技術，莫非要成為下一位「神奇小子」？在日落美景前歎盡精采美食，為周末假期畫上完美句號。兩位女生到臨五星級酒店，原來還為了一睹「靚仔」餅師的風采！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 「光環效應」是一種心理學上的認知偏差，意指人們會因人或事物的某個正面特質而將好印象擴散到整體評價。與之相反的是「角魔效應」，谷主瀅仴提到，這可從某齣時尚主題的荷里活電影中充分體現。兩種效應都反映了形象管理的重要，商品找明星代言正是利用這心理作用。人類重視第一印象，或源於大腦希望節省能量？谷主們討論光環效應可能產生的負面影響與應對方法。現今社會，藝人的日常生活更容易曝光，眾谷主可會擔心形象受此影響？

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 「閨密旅行團」正式出遊！陳敏之偕同高海寧、龔嘉欣前赴馬來西亞華人新村，選購地道特產，不忘展現慳家人妻本色，跟檔主講價。黎諾懿化身神秘檔主，為美女們送上驚喜。諾懿反客為主，推介環境清幽的竹林餐廳，品嚐農家菜與滋味河鮮。在豪華大屋安頓後，四人一邊打邊爐，一邊細說心底話。敏之提到想坐時光機回到過去再見亡父，不禁感觸落淚；嘉欣亦遺憾未能見爺爺最後一面。高Ling卻對生仔時刻充滿期待，難道有好消息準備公佈？

programme.title: 聲級學堂粵
programme.desc: 上一集，四組學員為考核全力以赴，成績卻未見突出。餘下的六組學員，能否從考官手上取得佳績？有學員全情投入聲演，七情上面時不慎走音。萬眾期待的「黑馬」組合，卻令考官大跌眼鏡。相反，同一條《金宵大廈》母子溫情片段，某組的合拍默契令人刮目相看！有組合為「馬季」、「啤啤」跳脫演繹；「小丸子」和「小玉」重新配音後，竟變出另類效果？十組學員完成考核，最優秀的三位配音學員順利誕生！鳳英老師、眾學員亦會剖白感受。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 越南漆器工藝需要不斷反覆進行上漆和打磨的工序, 是一種需要耐心等待嘅藝術 由以往只應用在寺廟或祠堂, 時至今日越南漆藝已經擴展到日常生活，由漆器到漆畫，由傳統工藝到新式工藝。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥德拉厄，這個船長小鎮，早年是鯡魚貿易中心，後海港沒落，繁華已逝，但老城區依然保留兩百年前的風貌。印度梅加拉亞邦是全國最不想生兒子的地方。女兒國凱西族婦女享有獨特社會地位，扮演著維繫家族血脈的角色。

programme.title: 季節限定 秋冬粵
programme.desc: 秋冬是欣賞蘆葦的好時機！嘉賓林穎彤由鹿頸出發，途經紅樹林抵達谷埔，見識壯麗的蘆葦花海；同場加映白鷺生態，如幸運還能遇見「秋冬限定」的蒼鷺。行山過後，主持們到訪主打爐端燒的日式餐廳，品嚐時令海鮮和蔬菜。士多啤梨既美味又有營養，還可入饌中和食材的油膩感。眾人走進有機農莊，即摘即吃士多啤梨，再向廚房型男請教士多啤梨菜式的烹調竅門。秋冬型格帽子，戴上保暖之餘，也可突顯個人風格；三位年輕「潮人」有何推介？

programme.title: 季節限定 秋冬粵
programme.desc: 薑黃擁有豐富藥用價值之餘，還有抗氧化作用！主持們下田挖掘薑黃，試製薑黃醬及鮮榨甘蔗薑黃汁。他們又順道摘取數款冬天當造蔬菜烹調菜式，搭配薑黃飯一起品嚐。秋冬服裝以深色為主調，如何利用配飾造型增強時尚味道？時裝設計師帶來飾物配襯小貼士。冬天容易手腳冰冷，更可能影響睡眠質素。今集推介蒸腳療程，藉着促進血液循環，改善怕冷問題。除了試吃多款新式煲仔飯暖胃，主持還請教湯水達人製作補氣益胃的「冬菇椰子烏雞湯」。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵PG
programme.desc: 何廣沛及楊潮凱在嘉年華會中挑選隊員，參與《大玩特玩》的特派任務。口含牛奶大玩機動遊戲，讓現場變得安靜，欣賞眾人有口難開的表情變成一件樂事。陳婉衡操控碰碰車，連撞對手車尾4個氣球，嚇破膽的卻是自己！玩遊戲最怕遇上「豬隊友」，朱智賢犯下不能原諒的錯，還膽敢推跌隊長，害自己成為被圍攻目標，甚至與爭終極大獎無緣。潮凱一下子完成攤位遊戲任務贏得金犬，卻被隊員嘲笑他只屬僥倖，是誰這麼「大口氣」？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生學習給小熊貓餵盆盆奶，還給牠們做了些玩具，小熊貓玩得不亦樂乎。老師們又帶領他們學習如何給熊貓量體重、在清理糞便時仔細檢查，記錄牠們的成長進度。最後跟他們來一次夜間巡視，學習基本的安全及防患意識。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 為了迎接聖誕節，Prism Stone正籌備寶石偶像雲集的盛大派對。另一方面，猶豫著是否要繼續隱瞞大家、將寶石選拔賽秘密藏於心底的虹之咲找黛雅商量。隨著聖誕節派對開始，虹之咲終於作出一個決定……

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日 及 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 世界級的星夢頻道慶典，國際星夢頻道大會簡稱WPC正於閃亮加坡舉行。為大會擔任大使的白鳥杏樹，踏上舞台介紹十位寶石偶像。另一邊廂，十大設計教主也正在召開會議，議題就是寶石時裝大賽的舉辦日期。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 多啦A夢突然努力溫習，原來他被發現學分不足，需要接受考試，不合格的話將被送返未來。大雄見堂哥五郎住公寓自由自在，好不羨慕，多啦A夢於是拿出「樹洞公寓」，大雄更邀請大家以低價租住。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 為了讓四個男團同時推出新歌，翼開始推動各項企劃，KITAKORE希望能請自己崇拜的歌手櫻田春樹幫忙寫歌，但要找到他本人似乎不容易，翼努力了很久都無法聯絡到那位歌手，KITAKORE和翼必須齊心克服這道難關。

programme.title: 出走澳洲粵
programme.desc: 塔斯曼尼亞周末市集出售各式手工製品，翠如、永城分道行逛，為對方選購貼心禮物；翠如特別附送吃剩一半的薄餅，認真老友！以蘋果為主題的酒廠兼餐廳，可享用多款蘋果酒和美食，二人還點喝一款混合蘋果酒、茶的熱飲，口味獨特又暖笠笠。「酒鬼」永城仍未盡興，再帶拍檔到訪以二百年古蹟為基地的酒廠，盡情品味Gin酒與獨家威士忌蛋糕。主持們於十年前曾獲一對農場夫婦盛情招待，這次重臨舊地跟故友相聚，勾起段段珍貴、感動回憶！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 只要花點技巧，平平無奇的家常菜也可「上大枱」！肥媽施展巧妙刀功，把茄子變身「蟠龍鱔」，奉上一道內外兼備的「蟠龍茄子」。銀鱈魚加上樹子、味醂等配料簡單蒸煮，即成「送飯」好菜式「蔥油樹子蒸銀鱈魚」。「日式牛蒡五味飯」採用五種不同味道的「有營」食材，色彩繽紛又健康。及後再來一道外脆內軟的甜品「拔絲番薯」，吃得特別滿足！另外，6號精心推介「蝶豆花茶」，「補腦」之餘，還可舒緩壓力，適合繁忙的都市人飲用。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一集，肥媽豪爽購入北海道毛蟹炮製一蟹兩食！她先參照潮州做法烹調凍蟹，另拆出蟹膏炒飯，吃盡鮮甜、甘香兩種滋味。肥媽笑稱要為6號以形補形，帶來「天麻川芎白芷燉豬腦」，順道示範豬腦的處理方法。想節省功夫做出脆皮燒肉？阿媽把五花腩放雪櫃冷藏一夜，配合刺針技巧，簡單易學。肥媽創製烏頭魚新煮意，把魚打鱗斬件，配上番茄汁、洋蔥汁，煮成「椰菜煮烏頭」。終極特飲，6號沖泡「蟲草胎菊麥冬茶」慰勞肥媽，有何效用？

programme.title: 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 災禍無情，為保障生命及財產安全，廣大市民務必時刻保持高度的防災意識。由馮盈盈、何晉樂等「星級」藝員參演的《防災貼士你要知 2》，以短劇形式向大家傳遞防止災害發生、遇危難時逃命的貼士,，還有消防處代表帶來相關知識與實用資訊。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 美功鐵路市場的位置貼近路軌，主持們見證兩旁檔販於火車經過時收攤讓路的奇景。前往大城府尋找星級大頭蝦美食，澄光指價錢比曼谷的相宜近半！四人盛裝享用Fine Dining印度菜，一道炭燒榴槤菜式，甫上桌已讓海寧雀躍尖叫。鏡頭一轉，慧中和星妤在湛藍的水池旁打卡，讓人仿如置身馬爾代夫，原來這是泰國的網紅咖啡店；煎吃椰奶餅，好食又好玩！石龍軍路一間泰式海南雞飯店的「鹹檸檬雞湯」讓澄光魂牽夢縈，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 主持們到訪曼谷野生動物園，跟長頸鹿、貓頭鷹等動物零距離接觸，三位「女神」還樂於被「明猩」強吻！海寧、慧中走進裝潢雅致的四十年代建築物食素菜，席間更來趟深入對談，海寧何故眼泛淚光？慧中偕星妤享受土耳其浴護膚後，還會體驗「冰火桑拿」。遊逛安多哥市場，海寧從低至高價試吃不同榴槤，果真一分錢一分貨！澄光帶慧中、星妤吃炭燒豬肉沙嗲再享用地道泰菜，當中「泰式咖喱炒蟹」香濃惹味，「蒜頭炒含羞菜」又是怎麼一回事？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 復活節將至，西方人大多會以復活蛋應節一番，一向「煮」意多多的古嘉俊(阿古)便為節日加添創意。這次，他邀請了朱智賢(Ashley)到來，合力炮製一款「迷你紅莓兔子蛋糕 」，透過口感特別的紅莓蛋糕，配以色彩繽紛的兔子及果汁豆裝飾，為復活節增添節日歡樂氣氛。蛋糕表層的脆皮可算是今次作品的其中主要亮點，箇中竅門原來與可可油與白朱古力有關。自言從未試過製作甜品的Ashley，她在今次學習過程中又有何得著？

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 翔太郎的右手手腕在大賽當天作痛，為趕及下午出賽，美里帶著翔太郎到醫院檢查。另一邊廂，蒼秀館最大勁敵白鳴高展示出壓倒性實力，在翔太郎可能缺陣的情況下，蒼秀館能否突破東北地區大賽？

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」，幾位表演者化身精靈的小松鼠，獻上一段芭蕾舞表演。正式演出前，先藉有關食物的心理測驗，看看自己適合在團體中擔任甚麼崗位。另一群小朋友以歌聲送上英文金曲<Fly me to the moon，配合歌詞做動作，為表演加添一份可愛。結他導師精選了兩首民謠<鳳陽花鼓和<Amazing Grace，與Tiffany姐姐和彤彤姐姐一同歡唱，還細談中國、印度音樂的音階特色。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 屁屁偵探在馬本的表演場地找到桃紅色頭髮男子，對方卻不知道什麼恐嚇信，反指丸尾才是寫信的人。丸尾羞怒之下逃走，被抓到後終於供出一切，原來他一直喜歡小鈴，寫的其實是情信而非恐嚇信。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小杉發現其他同學家裡有他不知道的獨特美食，於是成立「美食同好會」，並把花輪、小玉和小丸子拉入會。小丸子在電視上看到溫泉饅頭，十分想吃，爺爺於是帶她去百貨公司的物產展購買溫泉饅頭。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵 及 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 香港是「三高」女士，即高學歷、高收入、高職位女士的盛產地。在本港勞動人口當中，截至去年第三季，年過四十而從未結婚的女士有近23萬人，比同齡未婚男士多近47萬人。憎多粥少，「三高」女士想找條件相若的男士難，即使願意稍為放寬擇偶條件，男士亦可能「取易不取難」。這批女士如何保持情場競爭力？又有何方法自保呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 上環一幢大廈早前疑因大廈水管爆裂而導致停水，事故更令升降機暫停服務。居民生活受到嚴重影響，批評管理公司管理不善。再有市民墮進投資騙局，損失逾百萬元，詳情如何？有觀眾求助，指其住所的廁所天花出現滲水情況。樓上住戶找人進行維修，卻意外令事主單位的天花被鑿出大洞，鋼筋外露。測量師視察後認為滲水已損壞基本結構，天花板隨時有下墮危機……熱播劇《非常檢控觀》的演員為劇集宣傳，送上活動花絮。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: PK賽來到第三回，比拼張力更強，甫開始即有選手直取五燈晉級。評審谷婭溦的前戰友尹景順，唱出<愛與痛的邊緣，卻自覺發揮欠理想。蒙面藝人選手白羊君被抽中<趁早登場，眾評判對其震音甚有意見……曾獲五燈的吳亦偉透過輕快歌曲<冷水澡，帶動觀眾隨着節奏搖擺，能否晉級？上輪另一位五燈選手陳旭培再次以英文歌出戰，為何演唱其間不時望向添Sir？此外，被揀選上台PK的羅陽非一般跳唱<愛火花，獲封「中4舞王」。

programme.title: 華潤集團呈獻：無窮之路V — 智行無疆粵普
programme.desc: 本集見證中國綠能的“超級能源三叉戟”：敦煌熔鹽塔式光熱電站，以萬鏡追日，實現了太陽能的“日月同輝”；運達股份的16MW風電機組，以“一機抵萬戶”的颱風級動力，問鼎全球之最。華潤微電子則以一顆自主的“中國芯”，突破了綠色能源的最後一道壟斷壁壘。這是一場貫穿發電、裝備與核心部件的全鏈條突破。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 草蜢可謂香港男團的始祖，為成軍40年而辦演唱會，卻稱在視覺與主題上「無大突破」？但會於編曲搞搞新意思，一首歌也要先做幾個版本！好友透過視像向草蜢發問，杜德偉懷疑三子很久沒一起吃飯？伍詠薇針對問蔡一傑的「吻後感」，傑仔反提出愛四處吻的是蘇志威？草蜢的性格大鳴大放，愛玩的他們，大揭玩得瘋狂的時刻！三子同時亦會狠狠地吵架，難怪一直被傳出不和！更有指鄭伊健會專程看草蜢的騷前綵排，只為「觀看」三人鬧交？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩博士帶伍倩彤享用臘味盛宴，品嚐三十年陳皮鴨膶腸乳豬鍋巴、燕窩臘腸蛋撻等佳餚，並細說臘味的相關「嚐識」。行仔造訪一間主打各式飯類的餐廳，試吃椒鹽豬扒飯及招牌蝦頭油炒飯，炒功出色，米飯粒粒分明！倩彤再隨食評家劉晉享用以米作主題的韓國料理，包括韓國粥，搭配鰻魚湯的珍珠米飯，以及糯米年糕窩夫，令人回味無窮！大馬歌手劉界輝帶廖慧儀品嚐馬來西亞咖喱麵，湯麵配料豐富，湯汁濃郁；乾撈麵添加炸蒜，更加惹味！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 有個閨密叫祖藍粵
programme.desc: 這集，祖藍終可跟「網友」陳松伶來趟實體會面。北京初見，帶松松開展放鬆之旅，走進環境雅致獨特的養生餐廳，歇息一會，繼而解答「男神收割機」連串問題，松松對合作無間的拍檔黎明、鄭伊健和張智霖有何評價？她還笑言在家練成哎交技能，緣何解鎖？說到興起，松松一於反客為主，要了解祖藍的夫妻生活，並對其顧家男性格甚為欣賞。不停站「食好西」，席間，二人化身愛情信箱主持，松松更提及丈夫的窩心事，連愛妻號祖藍也自愧不如！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 上環一幢大廈早前疑因大廈水管爆裂而導致停水，事故更令升降機暫停服務。居民生活受到嚴重影響，批評管理公司管理不善。再有市民墮進投資騙局，損失逾百萬元，詳情如何？有觀眾求助，指其住所的廁所天花出現滲水情況。樓上住戶找人進行維修，卻意外令事主單位的天花被鑿出大洞，鋼筋外露。測量師視察後認為滲水已損壞基本結構，天花板隨時有下墮危機……熱播劇《非常檢控觀》的演員為劇集宣傳，送上活動花絮。

programme.title: 溜走的真味粵
programme.desc: 三位主持帶嘉賓楊潮凱拜訪當地飲食達人，享用「最潮」的Fusion菜。達人以地道食材入饌，還會為每道菜式配上一杯合適的潮州茶。用龍蝦湯煮花膠，味道怎樣？大家登上高山的茶園品茗，感受最地道的潮州功夫茶；德哥亦以在地特產的鳳凰單叢茶葉，炮製「煎封鯧魚卷」。這次三姐在山上開火，也用上單叢茶製作佳餚，嘉賓薛家燕亦再次尋味而至。單叢茶葉燻製的乳鴿，味道特別香濃；用茶蒸飯後再炒，每粒飯也散發陣陣茶香。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 美功鐵路市場的位置貼近路軌，主持們見證兩旁檔販於火車經過時收攤讓路的奇景。前往大城府尋找星級大頭蝦美食，澄光指價錢比曼谷的相宜近半！四人盛裝享用Fine Dining印度菜，一道炭燒榴槤菜式，甫上桌已讓海寧雀躍尖叫。鏡頭一轉，慧中和星妤在湛藍的水池旁打卡，讓人仿如置身馬爾代夫，原來這是泰國的網紅咖啡店；煎吃椰奶餅，好食又好玩！石龍軍路一間泰式海南雞飯店的「鹹檸檬雞湯」讓澄光魂牽夢縈，究竟有多滋味？

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 主持們到訪曼谷野生動物園，跟長頸鹿、貓頭鷹等動物零距離接觸，三位「女神」還樂於被「明猩」強吻！海寧、慧中走進裝潢雅致的四十年代建築物食素菜，席間更來趟深入對談，海寧何故眼泛淚光？慧中偕星妤享受土耳其浴護膚後，還會體驗「冰火桑拿」。遊逛安多哥市場，海寧從低至高價試吃不同榴槤，果真一分錢一分貨！澄光帶慧中、星妤吃炭燒豬肉沙嗲再享用地道泰菜，當中「泰式咖喱炒蟹」香濃惹味，「蒜頭炒含羞菜」又是怎麼一回事？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 復活節將至，西方人大多會以復活蛋應節一番，一向「煮」意多多的古嘉俊(阿古)便為節日加添創意。這次，他邀請了朱智賢(Ashley)到來，合力炮製一款「迷你紅莓兔子蛋糕 」，透過口感特別的紅莓蛋糕，配以色彩繽紛的兔子及果汁豆裝飾，為復活節增添節日歡樂氣氛。蛋糕表層的脆皮可算是今次作品的其中主要亮點，箇中竅門原來與可可油與白朱古力有關。自言從未試過製作甜品的Ashley，她在今次學習過程中又有何得著？

programme.title: 出走澳洲粵
programme.desc: 塔斯曼尼亞周末市集出售各式手工製品，翠如、永城分道行逛，為對方選購貼心禮物；翠如特別附送吃剩一半的薄餅，認真老友！以蘋果為主題的酒廠兼餐廳，可享用多款蘋果酒和美食，二人還點喝一款混合蘋果酒、茶的熱飲，口味獨特又暖笠笠。「酒鬼」永城仍未盡興，再帶拍檔到訪以二百年古蹟為基地的酒廠，盡情品味Gin酒與獨家威士忌蛋糕。主持們於十年前曾獲一對農場夫婦盛情招待，這次重臨舊地跟故友相聚，勾起段段珍貴、感動回憶！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 只要花點技巧，平平無奇的家常菜也可「上大枱」！肥媽施展巧妙刀功，把茄子變身「蟠龍鱔」，奉上一道內外兼備的「蟠龍茄子」。銀鱈魚加上樹子、味醂等配料簡單蒸煮，即成「送飯」好菜式「蔥油樹子蒸銀鱈魚」。「日式牛蒡五味飯」採用五種不同味道的「有營」食材，色彩繽紛又健康。及後再來一道外脆內軟的甜品「拔絲番薯」，吃得特別滿足！另外，6號精心推介「蝶豆花茶」，「補腦」之餘，還可舒緩壓力，適合繁忙的都市人飲用。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一集，肥媽豪爽購入北海道毛蟹炮製一蟹兩食！她先參照潮州做法烹調凍蟹，另拆出蟹膏炒飯，吃盡鮮甜、甘香兩種滋味。肥媽笑稱要為6號以形補形，帶來「天麻川芎白芷燉豬腦」，順道示範豬腦的處理方法。想節省功夫做出脆皮燒肉？阿媽把五花腩放雪櫃冷藏一夜，配合刺針技巧，簡單易學。肥媽創製烏頭魚新煮意，把魚打鱗斬件，配上番茄汁、洋蔥汁，煮成「椰菜煮烏頭」。終極特飲，6號沖泡「蟲草胎菊麥冬茶」慰勞肥媽，有何效用？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生學習給小熊貓餵盆盆奶，還給牠們做了些玩具，小熊貓玩得不亦樂乎。老師們又帶領他們學習如何給熊貓量體重、在清理糞便時仔細檢查，記錄牠們的成長進度。最後跟他們來一次夜間巡視，學習基本的安全及防患意識。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#34粵
programme.desc: 有情天生愛吃，她的老闆找她拍下婚紗廣告相，星探找她參加模特兒比賽，有情為不辜負期望，忍口戒吃。到了比賽前夕，有朋弄「蜜汁雞翼」給她，有情「欣賞雞翼」，有朋要有情悟出「人的道是自己選擇」的道理。

programme.title: 天龍八部#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 鳩摩智擄走學會六脈神劍的段譽，尋路前往燕子塢時遇見阿碧，阿碧划船相送，琴韻小築一位老婦人刁難鳩摩智，及後被他識破，原來老婦人由阿朱喬裝，阿朱、阿碧使計帶段譽逃走到曼陀山莊，段譽遇見與仙女像相似的語嫣…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺請阿譚外出吃撈麵，順道見識親身壓製的竹昇麵，果然有血有汗！炮製「廣東雲吞麵」，用豬骨、大地魚淆製的湯底，絕對是菜式的靈魂，烘香大地魚有何作用？阿譚試味後覺得湯底偏濃，鼎爺有辦法！餡料方面，赤米蝦雖小但鮮味搭夠，用鴨蛋可令蛋味提升。鼎爺再教授包雲吞及淥麵技巧。鼎爺、阿譚前往大澳，了解曬鹹蛋黃工序，再用它秘製暖笠笠的「鹹蛋膶腸肉餅飯」。鼎爺用油和酒醃香豬肉，還要緊記「四面楚歌」的焗煲仔飯貼士！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大腦是維持身體平衡的重要中樞，透過「腦力」鍛練可有效減低跌倒風險，腦神經科醫生分享強化訓練建議，也提醒屋中如光線不足，雜物過多都容易導致跌倒。他亦詳述撞傷頭部的應對，以及救治時的注意事項，並強調若出現持續頭痛、口齒不清等症狀，應及早求醫。花藝專家到臨，介紹喜慶花藝品種之餘，還以牡丹菊、紅綠掌等示範插花技巧，作品既美觀又富吉祥寓意，可為家居增添新春氣氛。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓奉上暖胃菜式「南瓜燜鴨」。

programme.title: 身體最誠實粵
programme.desc: 胸口痛可以有很多原因，怎樣的痛才是心臟引起？如果心痛於做運動時出現，會隨靜止而消失的話，尤其要注意！莫醫生代市民向心臟專家劉柱柏請教，劉教授還建議控制血壓、糖尿、體重，作為「養心之道」。此外，心臟科醫生高耀鈞指服藥治療心房顫動的成效普通，不少患者仍會復發，手術上有何新科技？長期以同一肩膊背手袋，有可能引致單邊痛楚，運動治療師傳授舒緩動作。身體易倦，或與肌肉流失有關，如何補充蛋白質方能有效改善情況？

programme.title: 單戀雙城#7粵
programme.desc: 展禛令餐廳廚房失火被解僱，式適託錢進收展禛為徒。麗詩提議錢進借酒對式適使米已成炊。式適看見惠心與貫天在一起，欲跟蹤二人卻被展禛破壞。展禛為了恭梓做水晶指甲，錢進發現命她洗掉，展禛寧被趕走堅決不從。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子的表弟廣明來到她家遊玩，更帶來了迷你玩具車，並因此引起了一場小騷動。宏志帶小丸子出外午膳，後者拾到花輪母親弄丟的手套，拿到對方家裡歸還時遇著下雨，結果兩人留下來避完雨才走。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集「Kids’ Notes」再次邀來航天學會會長，引領小朋友認識中國航天發展，當中的載人航天工程計劃原來早於1992年已展開。除了解釋酒泉被選址為航天發射場的原因外，嘉賓還提到火箭升空時，會向東邊飛行。他展示了三款長征火箭模型，原來火箭只需八分鐘便能將航天員送上太空！航天員在太空會執行多項任務，研究太空種子就是重要一環，嘉賓指這或是解決糧食問題的契機。中國亦積極推動探月工程，箇中與發電能源有關。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 爸爸媽媽要去參加親戚婚禮，不巧多啦A夢也有急事外出，只好留下「幫忙繩」照顧大雄。大雄的漫畫被媽媽全部丟掉，大受打擊，詎料不久後漫畫竟自動飛回家，全因多啦A夢用了「失物回歸噴霧」。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 樓市升溫，藍田一個指標屋苑樓價，一個月內上升百分之6，為甚麼表現突出？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2741粵
programme.desc: 龔燁被若水取笑，稱他跟不上潮流，遂打算設法改變。此時，龔燁發現城安、壯和凌凌打扮「極潮」，於是向他們取經，成功「轉型」。Ivan、Andy見龔燁「回春」，也隨他作改變。其後，城安等人發現，像龔燁般追趕潮流的中老年人越來越多，他們的穿著與年齡顯得格格不入。龔燁更憑藉財力盲目「扮潮」，卻對城安等帶來不少困擾……城安不想再被龔燁「跟風」，並想到一個令他知難而退的方法，詎料……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#16粵PG
programme.desc: 熊飛向希仁作認罪協商，希仁推測真兇身分，熊飛道出當年畫班的欺凌事件……熊飛提堂，希仁打破常規，不反對他保釋，引來公眾非議。德敬受輿論壓力，希仁以公職為熊飛擔保。熊飛往找真兇，勸其自首……再有人遇害喪命，熊飛再次被懷疑行兇，律政司遭公眾責難，德敬引咎辭職，希仁深感內疚。警方逮捕新命案疑犯，竟是熊飛認識之人。熊飛要設法取得證據，以洗脫自己的冤情……趙家眾人為德敬慶祝退休，頌星透露她將接替德敬之位。

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 韶光扮鬼嚇得劉墨供出馮掌櫃指使下毒，還沈家清白，林晏帶韶光飛上屋頂談心；中秋夜沈家人帶著飯菜到京兆府與林晏吃飯，開導思念家人的林晏，建設和鳳霞起爭執鬧離婚，韶光和林晏互相傾訴和開解，韶光喝醉親吻林晏。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 李丞責師傅帶CP曾展望、葉蒨文到訪佛山南風古灶，搶先參與在地傳統文化儀式，添柴是為加薪？公眾於年廿三可深入陶窰「投龍胎」，祈求通血脈，行好運！星級馬主黃嘉雯請教唐碧霞指點迷津，嘉雯想愛駒旺其事業，答案竟是相反？碧霞師傅亦帶來初三賀歲馬的當旺元素。潘靜文、林智樂、胡敏芝隨麥玲玲師傅遊逛福田的農產品批發市場，過年買水果拜神、入乾果待客自用，最緊要有意頭！車輛也會犯太歲？雲文子師傅以奇門遁甲數說一番。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
廉政行動2024#1粵PG
programme.desc: 廉政公署接獲投訴，富祥大廈業主懷疑維修招標過程涉及貪污。調查發現，除了「林氏工程」，多間參與競投富祥大廈維修工程的公司都因為不同原因自行退標，當中似乎有黑社會牽涉在內。司徒啓文從各蛛絲馬跡拼湊出整個貪污脈絡，發現背後神秘黑手，正是每天隱藏在中醫館內指點江山的「萬年建築」老闆霍萬聯。江見秋及全組調查員嚴陣以待，精心佈局，希望透過「林氏工程」老闆林強蒐集萬聯的罪證。誰知林強卻在重要時刻，幾乎露出破綻……

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大腦是維持身體平衡的重要中樞，透過「腦力」鍛練可有效減低跌倒風險，腦神經科醫生分享強化訓練建議，也提醒屋中如光線不足，雜物過多都容易導致跌倒。他亦詳述撞傷頭部的應對，以及救治時的注意事項，並強調若出現持續頭痛、口齒不清等症狀，應及早求醫。花藝專家到臨，介紹喜慶花藝品種之餘，還以牡丹菊、紅綠掌等示範插花技巧，作品既美觀又富吉祥寓意，可為家居增添新春氣氛。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓奉上暖胃菜式「南瓜燜鴨」。

programme.title: 身體最誠實粵
programme.desc: 胸口痛可以有很多原因，怎樣的痛才是心臟引起？如果心痛於做運動時出現，會隨靜止而消失的話，尤其要注意！莫醫生代市民向心臟專家劉柱柏請教，劉教授還建議控制血壓、糖尿、體重，作為「養心之道」。此外，心臟科醫生高耀鈞指服藥治療心房顫動的成效普通，不少患者仍會復發，手術上有何新科技？長期以同一肩膊背手袋，有可能引致單邊痛楚，運動治療師傳授舒緩動作。身體易倦，或與肌肉流失有關，如何補充蛋白質方能有效改善情況？

programme.title: 單戀雙城#7粵
programme.desc: 展禛令餐廳廚房失火被解僱，式適託錢進收展禛為徒。麗詩提議錢進借酒對式適使米已成炊。式適看見惠心與貫天在一起，欲跟蹤二人卻被展禛破壞。展禛為了恭梓做水晶指甲，錢進發現命她洗掉，展禛寧被趕走堅決不從。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#34粵
programme.desc: 有情天生愛吃，她的老闆找她拍下婚紗廣告相，星探找她參加模特兒比賽，有情為不辜負期望，忍口戒吃。到了比賽前夕，有朋弄「蜜汁雞翼」給她，有情「欣賞雞翼」，有朋要有情悟出「人的道是自己選擇」的道理。

programme.title: 天龍八部#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 鳩摩智擄走學會六脈神劍的段譽，尋路前往燕子塢時遇見阿碧，阿碧划船相送，琴韻小築一位老婦人刁難鳩摩智，及後被他識破，原來老婦人由阿朱喬裝，阿朱、阿碧使計帶段譽逃走到曼陀山莊，段譽遇見與仙女像相似的語嫣…

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 【《高斯電子公司》裴賢聖不當高富帥，與《精神教練諸葛吉》鄭宇奇蹟相遇】負債累累的熱血青年陸東柱，在以為是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力卻來歷不明名為「奇蹟」的少年。能夠深刻感受別人痛苦與絕望，也能治癒別人。為找回他的過去與記憶，兩人成為了彼此生命中的一個奇蹟相遇。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟(完)
programme.desc: 【《高斯電子公司》裴賢聖不當高富帥，與《精神教練諸葛吉》鄭宇奇蹟相遇】負債累累的熱血青年陸東柱，在以為是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力卻來歷不明名為「奇蹟」的少年。能夠深刻感受別人痛苦與絕望，也能治癒別人。為找回他的過去與記憶，兩人成為了彼此生命中的一個奇蹟相遇。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.desc: 關於友誼、成長，關於正義戰勝邪惡的故事。高中生麥斯的父親意外死亡，他搬回老家，找尋父親的過去，卻意外獲得超能力與一個飛行機器人，經由訓練後麥斯逐漸掌握這股力量，穿上盔甲發揮潛在力量變成鋼鐵戰士，以對抗威脅世界的神秘力量。

programme.title: 衝吧！小鐵人
programme.desc: 10位來自不同背景的孩子們，他們將一起挑戰小鐵人比賽，經歷90天的長征，與2160個小時的訓練，彼此互相扶持與鼓勵，用開闊與豁達突破自我、挑戰極限，成為獨立又自信的小大人。他們的目標不僅是完成這項超越大人的任務，更是向世界證明自己的實力與決心。

programme.title: 歡唱小浣熊(完)
programme.desc: 七隻頑皮小浣熊在神奇音樂盒開啟歡樂冒險！每集獻上趣味充滿想像力的歌曲，讓孩子快樂學習！透過語言遊戲激發創意、豐富詞彙！快來加入這場音樂與知識的奇妙盛宴吧！

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 金裝律師(完)
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 金裝律師(完)
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.desc: In Tuscosa, New Mexico, the Governor offers amnesty papers to all outlaws but gunfighter Clay McCord's appearance triggers a violent confrontation between the local marshal, McCord, and other outlaws.

programme.title: Harlequin
programme.desc: An ambitious Australian senator's son is cured of leukaemia by a faith healer, but he discovers that there is a high price to pay. The senator is overjoyed when his son is pronounced well, but then he learns that the mysterious healer has seduced his wife and is threatening to disrupt his political career.

programme.title: The Man Called Noon
programme.desc: Rubal Noon blazes a trail of vengeance across the West after his family is massacred. No one is safe from his blood lusting fury. Suddenly, Noon is Ambushed and falls victim to loss of memory. A mysterious desperado comes to his aid for unknown reasons. Noon holds the secret to a fortune in gold. The desperado along with many others impatiently wait for Rubal Noon’s Memory to return. And when he does remember -- all hell breaks lose!

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: As a nurse, Coffy (Pam Grier) has seen the ill effects of drugs up close, but it isn't until her little sister becomes addicted to heroin that she finally decides to wage a one-woman battle. Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.title: Crack In the World
programme.desc: Dr. Steven Sorenson (Andrews) plans to tap the geothermal energy of the Earth's interior by means of a thermonuclear device detonated deep within the Earth. Despite dire warnings by fellow scientist Ted Rampian (Moore), Dr. Sorenson proceeds with the experiment after secretly learning that he is terminally ill. This experiment causes a crack to form and grow within the earth's crust, which threatens to split the earth in two if it is not stopped in time.

programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Tree-Hole Frog

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Towel
programme.desc: Bella plays funny games with Lift using her colourful towel. Together, they visit Hettie in the Ice Disco, who uses a big towel to make up a new dance - the Butterfly Boogie!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun trying out games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Hat Badge
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up to the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Tag's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Aqueduct of Segovia

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Thomas Makes a Mistake
programme.desc: After Thomas makes a mistake with an important silk delivery in India, he causes chaos and confusion by not seeking help.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Magic Panic
programme.desc: Umbrella needs Sarah and Duck's help after he promises to put on a magic show.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Alarm Cluck

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Football
programme.desc: Stanley is called to help setup a football pitch so the children can play, although he must think on his feet when the weather turns, and the players start getting wet.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bell
programme.desc: The Town Hall clock is broken, it's lost its Ding Dong. It will take hours to fix, so Stanley asks noisy Fred if he will shout "DING DONG" when the big hand is pointing up.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - Stay Up
programme.desc: Rio is racing her remote-controlled car around the living room. She decides to make a garage for her car, just like her Dad's - but it's not very steady!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S2) - It's Time to Play in the Snow
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran, Ezra and Jaxon are all set for a day of sledging in the snow, but when the sledge breaks, Gran Gran comes up with a plan so that they all can keep having fun in the snow!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Exercise Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels set off on a warm-up run together. The Squirrels are feeling sleepy, but they are told that a bit of exercise will wake them up!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Music Video Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing a song they made, but they wish that they could see themselves perform. Duggee has a great suggestion, and they learn how to be creative.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Master of Puppets
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Seattle Space Needle, USA
programme.desc: The team goes where no Go Jetter has gone before, when Glitch tries to launch into space.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Avocado

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: Supertato and Tomato find themselves stuck in a slippery bathtub, whilst Evil Pea rampages around the supermarket on a giant soap-squirting machine.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Got Your Goat
programme.desc: Mojo Swoptops and best buddy Bo love to help their friends in the little town of Swoppiton. With a swop of Mojo's top and Bo's brilliant plans, they make an unstoppable team!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan

programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa‐Laa and Po follow a trail of flowers which leads them to some very special treasure.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: As the names of Chang Cheh and Liu Chia-liang became legendary, all-too-often the name of their equally valued collaborator, Tang Chia, is omitted. That may be, because, unlike the previous pair, the veteran kung-fu choreographer only went on to direct three movies of his own. Of course, that makes this trio all the more special, and this first effort perhaps the most special of all.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Hong Qi Qu - EP8
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Hong Qi Qu - EP9
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Bond With China
programme.desc: This documentary presents wonderful stories of China and the world, showcasing the Chinese spirit, the development of China and the spread of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Network News
programme.desc: Network News is a 30-minute programme focusing on news about China and the world.

programme.title: Dreamchaser
programme.desc: With the theme of "Ordinary People, Extraordinary Dreams", this documentary tells the wonderful life stories of such characters.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.
